openings.claim: Envelope pattern/quantity marks and post-insertion ticks could address quantity-memory omissions; exterior pattern marks could reduce assignment exchanges. Shared tags remain; O4 challenges their necessity.
openings.discriminator: Memory predicts cue benefits with shared trays; spatial interference predicts local-staging benefits. Correctly ticked incomplete envelopes defeat insertion checking; matched O4 replication can defeat memory dominance.
openings.probe: Same two volunteers: three matched four-kit batches, incumbent shared trays, marked/ticked shared-tray envelopes, and local staging without quantity cues. Cap preparation through audit at 18 minutes; tally crossings, timings and omissions against samples. Stop if staging exceeds table.
openings.uncertainty: Envelope legibility, staging footprint and probe feasibility unknown. O4 mixture and omission stage unknown; synthetic stipulations establish no benefits.

openings.claim: With shared trays, one volunteer picks; the other verifies open-envelope quantities/dimensions against its sample, corrects, marks exterior pattern and closes. Exchange roles between batches; replace deferred checking.
openings.discriminator: Integrated verification predicts intercepted errors; local picking predicts fewer initial errors. Equal residual omissions when comparison errors occur, mislabels, or failed full-run targets defeat relevant claims.
openings.probe: Within 90 minutes, compare matched twelve-kit incumbent/deferred and integrated-check batches using existing supplies. Record initial errors, corrections, residual omissions, assignment errors and total elapsed time; stop at cap.
openings.uncertainty: Fit concerns bounded probe. Verify accurate samples and stock. Zero-error comparison is inconclusive; full 60-kit throughput remains unproven.

decision: Test distinct mechanisms before selection. All work retains assigned quantities/dimensions, exactly two volunteers, at most 90 minutes, existing 180-by-75-centimetre table and supplies, with no purchases/equipment. Require 60 pattern-matched complete kits and at most one distribution correction. Neither opening establishes this outcome.
